Chapter 1: Introduction

1.1 College Profile

Vidhyadeep Institute of Computer & Information Technology (VICAIT) is a premier constituent college of Vidhyadeep University, managed under the esteemed auspices of the Vidhyadeep Charitable Trust. Established to impart advanced technological education, the institute is situated on a modern campus located at Anita (Kim), Taluka Olpad, District Surat – 394 110, Gujarat. VICAIT conducts specialized professional degree programs in computer applications, specifically Bachelor of Computer Applications (B.C.A.) and Master of Computer Applications (M.C.A.), aimed at nurturing skilled software professionals.

Pursuant to Section 1.2 of the VICAIT Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), the final-semester internship is an indispensable academic requirement designed to provide students with authentic industry exposure. The core objective is to afford candidates hands-on opportunities to understand enterprise workflows, apply modern software engineering methodologies, interact with senior technical mentors, and build verified, production-grade applications that bridge theoretical coursework with corporate software demands.

1.3 Project Profile

Project Title IT Asset & Support Desk Management System (Code Name: AssetDesk)
Project Category Enterprise Web Application / Internal IT Service Management (ITSM)
Architecture Three-Tier Client-Server Architecture (React SPA + Express REST API + MongoDB Database)
User Roles ADMIN (System Management), IT_SUPPORT (Desk Operations), EMPLOYEE (Self-Service)
Front-End Stack React 18.3, Vite 5.4, React Router 6.28, Axios 1.7, Vanilla CSS Design System
Back-End Stack Node.js 20 LTS, Express 4.21, Mongoose 8.9, JWT, bcryptjs, node-cron
Database System MongoDB 7/8 (Document-oriented NoSQL; Mongoose ODM with indexing & validations)
Deployment Targets Render (Node/Express API), Vercel (React Frontend), MongoDB Atlas (Cloud Database)
Duration & Hours {{company.duration}} (300+ Operational Development Hours)

Overview of the Project

The IT Asset & Support Desk Management System is engineered to address the systemic challenges of tracking physical hardware inventories, managing licensed software installations, and routing technical helpdesk tickets in organizational environments. By eliminating manual spreadsheets, the system provides automated asset lifecycle transitions, concurrency-safe equipment assignments, software license seat allocation guards, background expiration notifications, and strict SLA-governed support ticket resolution with complete historical auditability.

Core Functional Modules

Module Module Name Core Engineering Purpose
M1 Authentication & Users JWT-based session authentication, RBAC authorization, and user administration.
M2 Hardware Assets Physical hardware registry, serial verification, and employee assignment lifecycle.
M3 Software Licenses Seat quota enforcement, license key masking, and cron automated expiry warnings.
M4 Support Tickets Incident submission, priority triage, SLA due times, and 4-state resolution workflow.
M5 Audit & Reports Immutable security audit logging, KPI summary metrics, and CSV file exports.
